items.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake kills at least 47 in Indonesia
items.description: A search and rescue operation is under way to find survivors in Flores, an island in eastern Indonesia.

items.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
items.description: Security had been stepped up amid suggestions on social media of a second mass crossing on Saturday.

items.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
items.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

items.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
items.description: The declaration was made on the national day of the central European country, which has a population of just 44,000.

items.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
items.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

items.title: Multiple suspects at large after five shot at Virginia State University, police say
items.description: Police responded to reports of a shooting outside a residence halls at about 01:28 local time (05:28 GMT) on Saturday.

items.title: Hawaii braces for potential first direct hit by a hurricane in 34 years
items.description: In a worst-case scenario, category one Lala could dump up to 25in (63cm) of rain on Big Island.

items.title: Why is Australia's mushroom killer back in court this week?
items.description: The BBC’s Katy Watson explains why triple-murder Erin Patterson is back in court this week trying to overturn her conviction.

items.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
items.description: A father and his two young sons spent a night adrift before being rescued off the coast of the island of Koh Samui.

items.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported aboard
items.description: Thousands of sailors on the Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

items.title: Firefighters battle wildfire tearing through Belgian nature reserve
items.description: The fire burning through the major park was described as the country's worst in recent years.

items.title: BBC seeks to subpoena Trump's family members in Panorama lawsuit
items.description: The BBC's lawyers argue Trump's family members "have personal knowledge" of his intentions in the speech he gave outside the US Capitol on 6 January 2021.

claude-code.name: meeseeks
claude-code.description: Meeseeks is a Claude Code plugin. One command hands a specification to an autonomous loop that designs, builds, gates, audits and ships it - unattended - until it passes an enterprise definition of done, or the budget dies.

claude-code.name: rove
claude-code.description: Rove — the agent multiplexer in your shell. Multiplex your agents like you multiplex your terminals: run Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and Kimi in parallel, each session on its own git worktree and branch. Attach, detach, reattach; they keep working after you disconnect.
